aliases: Stadtwerke Hanau Gesellschaft mit beschränkter Haftung

officialEvidence.contractTariff: The current official Stadtwerke Hanau charging-card page publishes 4.49 EUR/month per active card, 0.29 EUR per charging session and 0.34 EUR/kWh AC at Stadtwerke Hanau charging points. AC charging in the ladenetz partner network is 0.52 EUR/kWh and DC is 0.65 EUR/kWh. Blocking is 0.10 EUR/min after 8 hours AC or 1 hour DC.

directPaymentFinding: The official page currently documents the RFID contract tariff but does not expose a separate current numeric QR/card ad-hoc tariff for Stadtwerke Hanau physical stations. Third-party current directories confirm the operator has public AC stations, but are not used to promote the contract tariff to ad-hoc pricing.
decision: Keep the exact official card/contract offer separate from physical CPO direct payment. No ad-hoc fallback is created. Defer representative station QR/direct checkout and authoritative EVSE namespace mapping until after breadth-first traversal.
nextAfterTraversal: Identify Stadtwerke Hanau physical EVSE IDs through BNetzA/Mobilithek and resolve any public direct-payment checkout values station by station.
